measurement: Raw recipe metrics and actual rendered stereo output are both included. Output master=1 includes .85 headroom, compressor and waveshaper. Fight bus taps include bus/category gains and actual music/ambience ducking, before shared reverb/master; final master is the actual limited destination.

benchmark.note: Main-thread wall time around synchronous buffer preparation and transferred-PCM copies, plus a 16ms responsiveness timer. Worker CPU time is excluded. Headless browser measurements are not a hardware frame-time certification.

loopBoundary.note: Raw cached PCM boundary before voice ramp. Endpoint continuity is exact; the 20ms edge energy reports any periodic loop dip.
